title: Minor consistency fixes: bc-version format, CI permissions, community skill retrieval
summary: Minor consistency improvements to quality rules documentation: standardized bc-version format notation, added explicit read-only permissions to validation workflows, and optimized community skill retrieval to use bounded domain-specific lookups.
key_points: Unquoted bc-version range format in two performance articles for consistency with other articles
Added explicit read-only contents permissions to four GitHub workflows for clarity
Community review skills now use bounded domain-specific retrieval instead of loading full index
